status: Analysis specification finalized before scoring for report reconstruction only; immutable execution freeze and file hashes are generated separately by evaluate_retrospective.py freeze.
scope: Retrospective report-reconstruction assessment of unchanged bundled MinION predictors on investigator-declared non-development cases. Not prospective, a measured live-accuracy estimate, or proof of equivalence to original training features.

cohort.selection: Investigator-described random cases; no formal probability sampling or consecutive recruitment documented.
cohort.specimens_libraries: Investigator confirms distinct specimens/libraries across the 20 cases.
cohort.forecast_influence: Investigator reports no NanoPredict forecasts used for run stopping.
cohort.patient_relationships: Investigator confirms all 20 cases are different patients; known flowcell reuse remains grouped.

extraction.feature_policy: Report-native inputs selected using explicit times or documented report bucket widths. Never read future bins, replace configured duration with actual duration, or use final yield as a predictor.
extraction.temperature: Linked HTML chart provides explicit seconds; identity and measured values verified against JSON. Use points at or before checkpoint; live stream aggregation equivalence remains unverified.
extraction.missing_values: Preserve missing with reason; use only frozen artifact preprocessing. No feature is entirely absent in the 60 candidate rows. Recent rates are absent at 11 first checkpoints, one passed-read-length ratio is undefined, and one translocation boxplot is empty. Recent-rate comparator availability is reported separately.
extraction.zero_values: Proto3 scalar omissions are zero only inside a present, schema-typed message; zero denominators yield missing derived ratios. Empty boxplot bins yield missing, not zero.
extraction.live_equivalence: Not established. Report bins are 10 or 30 minutes; deployed recent-rate and boxplot windows differ. Resolve and label these differences before making deployment accuracy claims.
extraction.pore_scan: Corrected helper follows explicit metadata groups, including multiple/other under inactive. Source change made before scoring; original training-extractor equivalence remains unverified.
extraction.scope_decision: Use the native report bucket widths as reconstructed inputs, without interpolation or a claim that they reproduce live windows. This is the prespecified estimand for this retrospective analysis. Contemporaneous basecall availability, original training feature parity, and checkpoint configuration history remain unknown and limit interpretation rather than being labelled verified.

endpoint.name: Observed-ending final passed yield, Gb (1e9 bases)
endpoint.source: Acquisition final report yield reconciled with matching sequencing-summary passed template lengths after basecalling completes; reconcile scope/split/duplex semantics before accepting totals.
endpoint.early_stops: Retain S7 and S15. Do not extrapolate observed outcomes to planned completion.
endpoint.configurations: Retain configured 72 h for S15 and 6 h for S16 in candidate model inputs; intended 3 h workflow stored separately.
endpoint.disagreements: Keep unresolved outcomes missing; never choose the outcome source producing better model accuracy.
endpoint.reconciliation_status: All 20 passed-base totals and passed-read counts match sequencing summaries exactly; no duplicate/missing read IDs or foreign run IDs found.

baseline_settings: Reuse the developmental baseline specification in independent_protocol.md, with its fixed seed and replay-only partitions; never fit baselines on these 20 outcomes.

additional_metrics: paired MAE difference versus cumulative-rate extrapolation
descriptive Brier scores and event counts at 1, 5, 10 Gb
analysis.comparison_population: Same eligible runs for compared methods at each checkpoint, plus explicit per-method availability and missingness. A missing recent rate must not silently remove a run from the entire study.
analysis.uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed related-group bootstrap replicates (seed 20261008), paired across methods and separate by horizon; snapshots are not independent replicates.
prespecified_descriptive_summaries: reported protocol completion versus adjudicated sufficient-data stops
reported duration and kit summaries without claims of causal library effects
analysis.prespecified_sensitivity: Repeat point comparison excluding the two confirmed configuration mistakes S15/S16; show exclusions and compare to main analysis. Do not substitute intended duration or select whichever result looks better.
analysis.no_tuning: No model selection, retraining, recalibration, target selection or favorable exclusion based on these results.
analysis.interval_interpretation: Coverage is descriptive for reconstructed inputs and observed-ending outcomes in this selected cohort; nominal levels are not calibration guarantees. Group-bootstrap percentile intervals are conditional on this small cohort and may be unstable, especially the two intentional stops.
analysis.execution: tools/paper/evaluate_retrospective.py; 2000 group-bootstrap draws with seed 20261008. Report per-method available cases; paired MAE differences use the intersection with cumulative-rate extrapolation. Probabilities are descriptive Brier scores with event/non-event counts; no calibration fitting.

freeze_gates: Resolved for limited scope: report-native extraction definitions are fixed; live/training parity remains an explicit limitation.
